Assess Script Complexity

Source: R/repro_indicators.R
assess_script_depth.Rd

Reports the deepest brace nesting across the scripts. Deeply nested code is hard for a reviewer to follow, so exceeding config$max_script_depth is a low severity warn. Returns evidence with indicator_id = "R-REPRO-007".

Usage

assess_script_depth(path, ctx = NULL, config = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path to the submission's analysis code folder.

ctx

A run context from r4subcore::r4sub_run_context(). When NULL a default context is created from the folder name.

config

A configuration from repro_config_default(). When NULL the default configuration is used.

Value

A validated evidence table.

Examples

d <- file.path(tempdir(), "sub007")
dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines("f <- function(x) x + 1", file.path(d, "a.R"))
ev <- suppressMessages(assess_script_depth(d))
ev$result
#> [1] "pass"
